description:
`FileLocker` repeats one poll loop three times, and keeps test-only non-blocking variants and a lock-path accessor under `allow(dead_code)`.

## Background

In `crates/jit/src/storage/lock.rs`, `lock_exclusive` (`:213-241`), `lock_shared` (`:254-281`) and `lock_exclusive_with_metadata` (`:347-395`) each carry their own poll loop. `try_lock_exclusive` (`:292-302`) and `try_lock_shared` (`:313-325`) are called only from in-crate unit tests: `lock.rs:532-749` and `storage/claim_coordinator.rs:1589,2698,2700`, all under `#[cfg(test)]`. `LockGuard::path()` (`:145-148`) and its field `path` (`:113`), both under `allow(dead_code)`, are read only by tests (`lock.rs:512,807,827`). `Drop` does not read `path`. `lock_cleanup.rs:98` calls fs4's `File::try_lock_exclusive`, not `FileLocker`'s.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `FileLocker` acquires exclusive, shared and metadata-writing locks through one private poll loop.
- [hard] REQ-02: `try_lock_exclusive`, `try_lock_shared`, `LockGuard::path` and the guard's path field exist only in test builds and carry no `allow(dead_code)`.
- [hard] REQ-03: The existing lock tests pass, including timeout and contention behaviour.

## Notes

The metadata-writing lock writes its metadata after the shared loop returns.
title: Give the file lock one poll loop
